extrusion-inventory.overview: Inventory management built around how an aluminium extrusion unit actually runs: billet stock, die usage and profile output.

powder-coating-inventory.overview: Coating stock, job batches and colour and finish variants tracked from the extrusion yard through the coating line.

aluminium-stock-management.overview: An inventory system for aluminium businesses covering materials and hardware, and extrusion bundles, dispatch and stock.

brokersnet.overview: A PropTech platform with backend-driven property listings, interactive map search and advanced filters, delivered as Android and iOS apps and configured from an admin panel.
